_comment: Curated SBP EasyData selection for Data Darbar, chosen 2026-08-16.
Run with:  python3 build_sbp.py plan --select --tier headline core
Series counts below are measured from live dataset metadata, not guessed.
Entries are {dataset} for all series, {dataset, include|exclude} for a regex
on the series name, or {series:[...]} for exact keys.

headline.description: ~20 series that carry a macro dashboard on their own. Exact keys, verified against live metadata. Pull this first - it is cheap and immediately usable in finance.html.

entries._note: E00220 = average PKR per U.S. Dollar, monthly from Aug-1947. R/N00010 = REER/NEER base 2010. An overvalued-rupee chart is just REER against 100.
SBPOL0030 = policy (target) rate, as-needed since Jan-1956 - the single longest policy-rate series available anywhere for Pakistan. KIBOR0030 = 6-month offer rate, daily.
National / urban / rural / urban-food / rural-food CPI, YoY percent, 2015-16 base. The urban-rural food gap is a good story on its own.
Total workers' remittances monthly from Jul-1972, plus the seasonally adjusted version. SWR0002 verified against live metadata 2026-08-30 (SWR0001 = raw, SWR0002 = seasonally adjusted).
Real GDP level (Mn PKR, 2015-16 basic prices) and its growth rate. Level reconciles exactly with warehouse national_accounts.

entries.entries_note: EPU has only 2 series, take both

core.description: The full small-to-medium datasets behind those headlines, so charts can be broken out without another API run. ~1,300 series, comfortably inside one day's 1,900 budget.

entries._why: quarterly GDP - the only high-frequency real-activity aggregate
POL sales by sector, a good activity nowcast
FX and gold reserves from Jun-1948
exports and imports of goods and services
remittances by source country - a strong map/treemap candidate
PKR against 24 currencies, monthly from Aug-1947
inflation snapshot, all cuts, current base
consumer confidence (count verified 2026-08-30). NOTE: this dataset's JSON contains raw control characters; handled by decode_payload()
weighted average lending and deposit rates
province-wise advances and deposits. The ONLY sub-national dataset worth mapping - 9 regions x 9 categories. Stops Jun-2023.

granular.description: Country- and commodity-level detail. ~1,100 series, so this is a second day of budget. Only worth it if you want treemaps/flow maps rather than line charts.

entries._why: export receipts by country, monthly - payments-basis complement to trade_hs8
services exports by country - NOT in the PBS customs data at all

deep_history.description: Long historical runs that no other Pakistani source publishes machine-readable. Cheap and high archival value.
